test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate 'one word' for the expression given below.**

One who has persistent neurotic impulse to steal
solution: The correct answer is "**Kleptomaniac**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Kleptomania **is a mental disorder characterized by an **irresistible urge to steal items that are not needed or have little value**. A person with kleptomania may feel **a sense of tension before committing theft and relief or gratification afterward**, even though they may not use or sell the stolen items. (चोरी करने की बीमारी से पीड़ित व्यक्ति) • Therefore, the appropriate word to describe a person with this disorder is "kleptomaniac." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Connoisseur **refers to an expert or knowledgeable person in a particular field, usually related to art, wine, or food. (कला, स्‍वादिष्‍ट भोजन, संगीत आदि का विशेष जानकार; गुणग्राहक) • **Hypocrite **refers to a person who pretends to have moral or religious beliefs, principles, etc., that they do not actually possess or follow. (पाखंडी, ढोंगी) • **Iconoclast** refers to a person who attacks or criticizes established beliefs or customs. (रूढ़िगत विचारों का विरोधी) 3c:T762, The correct answer is "**Foster**".
